items.label: word

items.definition: a thing that is added to something else

items.label: word

items.definition: to respect somebody for what they have done or to respect their qualities

items.example: It was a stupid thing to do, I admit.

items.label: word

items.definition: having the most modern and recently developed ideas, methods, etc.

items.definition: an arrangement, a promise or a contract made with somebody

items.example: statistical/data analysis

items.definition: the detailed study or examination of something in order to understand more about it; the result of the study

items.definition: to tell people something officially, especially about a decision, plans, etc.

items.example: to make an announcement

items.definition: a spoken or written statement that informs people about something

items.label: word

items.label: word

items.exampleVi: Chuyến đi mất khoảng bảy tiếng.
items.definition: used to show that something is almost, but not completely, accurate or correct
